roles.title: Director of Product, Supply Chain Systems

bullets: Partner closely with our customers’ supply chain and manufacturing organizations to gain a continuous understanding of their work–the good, the bad, the ugly.
Anticipate the capabilities that our customers need and translate them into clearly-defined product requirements that drive our design and engineering work.
Own end-to-end roadmap for Supply Chain OS, including priorities, development schedule, and release sequencing.
Author release communications for both existing customers and prospects, across every channel.
Work with Product Managers across Heliux to ensure the platform is greater than the sum of its modules.
Partner closely with our customers’ engineering and operations organizations to gain a continuous understanding of their work–the good, the bad, the ugly.
Anticipate the capabilities that our customers need and translate them into clearly-defined product requirements that drive our design and engineering work.
Own end-to-end roadmap for Engineering OS, including priorities, development schedule, and release sequencing.
Author release communications for both existing customers and prospects, across every channel.
Work with Product Managers across Heliux to ensure the platform is greater than the sum of its modules.
